technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals present but severely undermined by bearish structure, weak trend confirmation, and absence of bullish crossovers—high false-signal risk in downtrend.

fundamental.summary: EQR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 49 days.

sentiment.summary: Weak buy signal from junior congressman with small purchases over 6 months; broad market fear (37 Fear/Greed score, 52% bearish) presents contrarian opportunity but insufficient conviction to override negative sentiment backdrop.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (236) indicates extreme market stress, and real estate sector faces credit tightening; earnings in 49 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold RSI (9/14), StochRSI cross-up, 15x volume spike, and CMF cross-up signal potential bounce from support (50.67) in extreme fear environment (VIX 236, Fear/Greed 37).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, weak ADX trend confirmation, thick Ichimoku cloud overhead, no triggered strategies, and macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, real estate credit stress) make this a high-probability false-signal bounce in active downtrend.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold technicals (RSI 9/14, StochRSI cross-up, 15x volume spike) present bounce potential at support in extreme fear environment. However, bearish structure (price below all MAs, bearish MACD, weak ADX, thick Ichimoku cloud) and macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, real estate credit stress) create high false-signal risk.
decision.primary_risk: Macro recession signals (inverted yield curve, VIX 236, real estate sector credit tightening) combined with earnings event in 49 days make this a likely false bounce in active downtrend with asymmetric downside risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
